title: session-plan-v0.1
description: The plan of one connected session that streamsim plantwire connect runs until it is stopped: the plant, the plant wire host it links to, an optional gateway, and which plant instances are real boards behind that gateway. The plant does not change: every instance not named in real is simulated.

domain.x-expected: a domain id: 3 to 64 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter

host_socket.description: The owner-only unix socket the plant wire host listens on.

gateway_socket.description: The owner-only unix socket the session creates and a gateway dials; absent for a session of simulated boards only.

real.description: The instances that are real boards: each is the device a gateway board announces. A real instance needs gateway_socket.

policies.description: The policy digests this session's simulated devices accept in a command's policy_digest. Absent: none, and every command to a simulated device except a safe stop is refused policy_not_allowed. Real boards are checked by the gateway's own list.

items.x-expected: a policy digest: sha256: and 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits

disturbances.description: Faults the session injects into its simulated world: each starts at_s seconds after the world starts and, with duration_s, is cleared that much later. They are injected when the session starts, recorded in the run's command log and its sealed truth like any injected fault, and never sent to the host or echoed in the check or the journal. Equal times are applied in list order.

pace.description: wall: the world starts at the wall time the session starts (recorded in run.json as the world start time, so a replay reproduces it) and each slice is released when the wall clock reaches its world time, so world time is UTC; the barrier stays a cap. Absent: slices follow one another as fast as the host answers.

socket.x-expected: an absolute path of at most 103 characters without control characters or a .. component, the length a unix socket path may have

at_s.description: Seconds after the world starts; at most 30 days, the longest run.

instance.description: The simulated plant instance the fault strikes.

fault.description: A fault the instance's kind declares.

duration_s.description: Seconds until the fault is cleared; absent, it lasts. A pulse fault has its own duration and takes none.

severity.description: The fault's severity; the domain's magnitude when absent.

instance.description: The plant instance the real board stands for.

board.description: The board the gateway announces in its NBIRTH.

device.description: The device on that board that is the instance.
